newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Refugio gold mine still shut after 12 days.
newsitem.headline: Chile Refugio gold mine still shut after 12 days.

text.p: Chile's Refugio gold mine remained closed Wednesday for the twelfth day as snow ploughs continued working to clear snow from roads to the pit, said human resources manager Anibal Avendano.
"Weather conditions are good but the problem is clearing the road -- there's too much snow for the machines," Avendano told Reuters.
Around 10 snowploughs are working to clear the 200 kilometer road from Copiapo to the mine which lies high in the Andes near the border with Argentina.
Management from the mine, owned equally by Bema Gold Corp and Amax Gold, were flying by helicopter to the pit Wednesday to assess the situation, he said.
Violent blizzards over a week ago cut access roads to the mine and dumped more than two meters of snow over the open-cast pit.
The mine processes 30,000 tonnes of mineral daily and is designed to produce 230,000 ounces of gold a year when running at full capacity.
